documents.title: CER: LED high-bay retrofit (draft for January)

versions.author: worker
versions.content:
# CER: Groveport LED high-bay retrofit (draft for the January capital review)

Scope: replace 380 metal-halide high bays with LED fixtures and motion sensors (Brightside Energy quote, $42,000).
Approver: Regional VP (FIN-104, capital up to $50,000).
Net cost: $42,000 - $9,500 AEP Ohio rebate = $32,500. The rebate needs AEP pre-approval before purchase; Brightside applied 11/5, decision in about 30 days. Without it, $42,000.
Savings: $1,000 a month from our last 12 AEP bills (Brightside estimated $1,050). Payback 32,500 / 1,000 = 32.5 months (42 months without the rebate).
Other benefits: better light in the picking aisles (accuracy), less re-lamping.
Disposal: the 380 metal-halide lamps go to a universal-waste lamp recycler (Brightside's subcontractor), with the certificate of recycling in our file; our current lamp box ships separately before its one-year date.
Timing: install in January after peak, aisle by aisle on weekends.
Recommendation: approve for January, subject to the AEP pre-approval.
